_comment: Removed a fabricated delayed PAY_OR_DAMAGE. The card says 'their first attack during their next turn COSTS AN ADDITIONAL {r}' -- a cost INCREASE -- and it was authored as 'pay 1 or take 1 damage' at the start of their turn, gated on REF_PITCH_IS over a ref named ATTACKER that nothing stores. Wrong mechanic, wrong timing, and an unsettable gate. NOT IMPLEMENTED: there is no cost INCREASE path; the queued cost mods only reduce, and none is scoped to an opponent's next attack.
